While the bubbles are roughly spherical, the fusion artifacts on the left side distort the geometry of at least one major bubble, compromising its 'perfect' spherical nature. The 'Fragile structure' checkpoint was correctly marked untestable. The alignment assessment is strong because the primary class features are visually dominant despite the structural flaws.

The Router underestimated the severity of the hand/wand interaction; the structural collapse of the wand connection combined with the finger ambiguity suggests a more significant generation failure in the interaction zone (Severity should be closer to 3.0 for the hand-wand complex).
